messages.subject: [genoPlotR-help] Help with genoPlotR
messages.body_plain:
Dear Tuan,

Yes, there are ways to re-make this plot in genoplotr. To explore the possibilities, look at the examples in http://genoplotr.r-forge.r-project.org/screenshots.php
You can also explore the examples directly in R:
> library(genoPlotR)
> help(plot_gene_map)
> example(plot_gene_map)

To plot your own gene symbols/arrows, look into
> help(gene_type)
> example(gene_type)

To add graphs to each segment, look at 
> help(seg_plot)
> example(seg_plot)

Best regards,

Lionel
